title: Agreement between subject and verb (2)
summary: Согласование при выражениях количества (a number of / the number of, half of, none of, neither of), after one of ... who, в конструкциях there is / are, в придаточных-подлежащих и в предложениях со сказуемым-дополнением.
ru:
## Выражения количества: a number of и the number of
Глагол определяется тем, какое слово является **ядром** подлежащего. Сравните:
> **A number of** problems **have** been reported. — Сообщили о ряде проблем. (a number of = «несколько», мн. число)
> **The number of** problems **has** increased. — Число проблем выросло. (the number = «количество», ед. число)
То же с **a couple of / a variety of / a range of**: *A range of options **are** available.* — обычно множественное число. А вот **a great deal of / a lot of / plenty of** согласуются со словом, следующим после **of**: *A lot of **time was** wasted. A lot of **people were** upset.*

## Дроби, проценты, half of, the majority of
Существительное после **of** задаёт форму глагола:
> Half of **the cake is** gone. / Half of **the guests have** left.
> Forty per cent of **the budget was** spent. / Forty per cent of **the voters are** undecided.
**the majority of / the rest of / most of / all of / some of** подчиняются тому же правилу. Слово **majority** само по себе, без **of**, может быть и ед., и мн. числом (*The majority **is / are** in favour* — в британском английском).

## none of, neither of, either of, each of
- **none of + мн. число**: *None of the candidates **is / are** suitable.* Формально — ед. число, в обычной речи часто мн. числом. **None of the water** — всегда ед. числом (неисчисляемое).
- **neither of / either of**: *Neither of the answers **is** correct.* В разговоре встречается и *are*, но на письме и на экзамене надёжнее ед. число.
- **each of / every one of / one of**: всегда ед. число: *Each of the rooms **has** a balcony.*
- **a majority of** + мн. число → мн. числом: *A majority of experts **agree**.*

## one of ... who/which и the only one of ... who
Когда относительное местоимение **who / which / that** относится к существительному во множественном числе, глагол тоже множественный:
> She is **one of those people who like** to plan everything. — Она из тех людей, кто любит всё планировать.
> He is **the only one of the engineers who knows** the system. — Он единственный из инженеров, кто знает эту систему.
Во втором случае **the only one** — единственный, поэтому *knows*. Без **the only**: *one of the engineers who **know***.

## there is / there are
Глагол обычно согласуется с **первым** существительным после *there*: *There **is** a table and two chairs in the room.* / *There **are** two chairs and a table.* В разговорной речи часто используют *there's* и с множественным числом (*There's two people waiting*), но в формальном письме это считается небрежностью. С *there seems / appears / used to be* правило то же.

## Подлежащее-придаточное и инфинитив
- Придаточное предложение как подлежащее — **единственное число**: *What he said **was** surprising.* / *Whether they win or lose **doesn't** matter.*
- Но **what**-придаточное согласуется по смыслу с тем, что дальше: *What we need **is** more time.* / *What we need **are** more volunteers.* (допустимо)
- **Герундий и инфинитив** как подлежащее — ед. число: *Learning languages **takes** time. To forgive **is** hard.*
- **the + прилагательное** (обозначает людей): *The poor **need** more support.* — мн. число.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~A number of problem has been reported.~~ → A number of **problems have** been reported.
- ~~The number of unemployed people have grown.~~ → The number of unemployed people **has** grown.
- ~~Each of the students have a laptop.~~ → Each of the students **has** a laptop.
- ~~She is one of the people who likes sushi.~~ → ...who **like** sushi.
- ~~There is two options.~~ → There **are** two options.
en:
## Quantity expressions: a number of and the number of
The verb agrees with the **head** noun of the subject. Compare:
> **A number of** problems **have** been reported. (a number of = 'several', plural)
> **The number of** problems **has** increased. (the number = 'the total', singular)
The same applies to **a couple of / a variety of / a range of**: *A range of options **are** available.* But **a great deal of / a lot of / plenty of** agree with the noun after **of**: *A lot of **time was** wasted. A lot of **people were** upset.*

## Fractions, percentages, half of, the majority of
The noun after **of** decides the verb:
> Half of **the cake is** gone. / Half of **the guests have** left.
> Forty per cent of **the budget was** spent. / Forty per cent of **the voters are** undecided.
**the majority of / the rest of / most of / all of / some of** follow the same rule. On its own, **majority** can take a singular or plural verb in British English: *The majority **is / are** in favour.*

## none of, neither of, either of, each of
- **none of + plural noun**: *None of the candidates **is / are** suitable.* Formally singular, but plural is common in speech. **None of the water** is always singular (uncountable).
- **neither of / either of**: *Neither of the answers **is** correct.* You may hear *are* in conversation, but singular is safer in writing and exams.
- **each of / every one of / one of**: always singular: *Each of the rooms **has** a balcony.*

## one of ... who/which and the only one of ... who
When the relative pronoun **who / which / that** refers to a plural noun, the verb is plural:
> She is **one of those people who like** to plan everything.
> He is **the only one of the engineers who knows** the system.
In the second sentence **the only one** is the single person, so the verb is *knows*.

## there is / there are
The verb usually agrees with the **first** noun after *there*: *There **is** a table and two chairs in the room.* / *There **are** two chairs and a table.* In informal speech people say *there's* with plural nouns (*There's two people waiting*), but this is avoided in formal writing.

## Clauses and infinitives as subjects
- A clause as the subject takes a **singular** verb: *What he said **was** surprising.* / *Whether they win or lose **doesn't** matter.*
- A *what*-clause agrees with the complement: *What we need **is** more time.* / *What we need **are** more volunteers.* (acceptable)
- **Gerunds and infinitives** as subjects take a singular verb: *Learning languages **takes** time.*
- **the + adjective** (meaning people) takes a plural verb: *The poor **need** more support.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~The number of unemployed people have grown.~~ → The number of unemployed people **has** grown.
- ~~Each of the students have a laptop.~~ → Each of the students **has** a laptop.
- ~~She is one of the people who likes sushi.~~ → ...who **like** sushi.
- ~~There is two options.~~ → There **are** two options.
structure:
## Количество и согласование
| Подлежащее | Глагол | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| a number of + мн. | мн. | A number of employees **have** resigned. |
| the number of + мн. | ед. | The number of employees **has** fallen. |
| a lot of / plenty of + сущ. | по сущ. | A lot of **money was** lost. |
| half / most / the rest of + сущ. | по сущ. | Most of **the work is** done. |
| each of / every one of | ед. | Each of us **has** a key. |
| either / neither of + мн. | ед. (формально) | Neither of them **is** here. |
| none of + мн. | ед. или мн. | None of them **is / are** ready. |

## one of ... who
| Конструкция | Глагол | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| one of the + мн. + who | мн. | She is one of the people who **know**. |
| the only one of the + мн. + who | ед. | She is the only one of the people who **knows**. |

## Придаточное и герундий
> **What** she said **is** true. · **Whether** he comes **doesn't** matter.
> **Learning** a language **takes** years. · **To err is** human.

exercises.title: is, are, has или have?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужную форму глагола в скобках. Если допустимо несколько вариантов, укажите все.

items.text: The number of tourists {{has}} risen sharply this year.
A number of students {{have}} already submitted their projects.
Each of the apartments {{has}} its own entrance.
Half of the staff {{are|is}} working from home.
Half of the information {{is}} out of date.
The rest of the equipment {{was}} delivered on Tuesday.

exercises.title: one of ... who
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в нужную форму (present simple).

items.text: She is one of those teachers who {{inspire}} their students.
He is the only one of my colleagues who {{speaks}} Chinese.
This is one of the books that {{have}} changed my life.
Marta is the only one of the applicants who {{has}} relevant experience.
He is one of the few people who {{understand}} quantum physics.
It's the only one of the proposals that {{makes}} sense.

exercises.title: Выберите правильную форму
exercises.instruction: Выберите вариант, в котором глагол согласован верно.

items.q: The number of cars on the road ___ increased dramatically.
items.why: the number of — ядро number, ед. число.

items.q: A great deal of money ___ spent on the project.
Every one of the players ___ a medal.
items.why: Every one of — всегда ед. число: has received.

items.q: What the committee wants ___ a clear answer.
items.why: Придаточное what-clause согласуется с дополнением: a clear answer (ед. число).

items.q: There ___ a computer and two printers in the office.
items.why: Глагол согласуется с первым существительным: a computer.

items.q: The young ___ often more adaptable to change.
Eating a lot of sugar ___ bad for your health.

options: She is one of those people who prefers silence.
She is one of those people who prefer silence.
She is one of those people who preferring silence.
items.why: who относится к people (мн. число) → prefer.

options: A number of mistakes was found in the report.
A number of mistakes were found in the report.
A number of mistake were found in the report.
items.why: a number of = несколько; мн. число.

options: The majority of the experts agrees with the proposal.
The majority of the experts agree with the proposal.
The majority of the experts agreeing with the proposal.
items.why: После the majority of + мн. существительное глагол обычно во множественном числе: agree.

options: Each of the members have a vote.
Each of the members has a vote.
Each of the members are having a vote.
There is several reasons for the delay.
There are several reasons for the delay.
There be several reasons for the delay.
He is the only one of the guests who were late.
He is the only one of the guests who was late.
He is the only one of the guests who are late.
items.why: the only one — единственный человек: ед. число.

exercises.title: Перепишите предложение
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово или выражение в скобках, чтобы смысл остался прежним.

items.prompt: Several employees have asked for a pay rise. (a number of) → A number of ...
answers: A number of employees have asked for a pay rise.

items.prompt: The total of complaints has fallen. (the number of) → The number of ...
answers: The number of complaints has fallen.

items.prompt: (Tom / be / one of the people / who / like / quiet evenings)
answers: Tom is one of the people who like quiet evenings.
What we need is more time.

items.prompt: Not one of the answers was correct. (None) → None of ...
answers: None of the answers was correct.
None of the answers were correct.

items.prompt: She is the only student who has passed. (the only one of) → She is the only one of ...
answers: She is the only one of the students who has passed.
She is the only one of the students who passed.

exercises.title: Исправьте ошибки
exercises.instruction: В каждом предложении есть ошибка согласования. Перепишите предложение верно.

items.prompt: The number of applicants are growing every year.
answers: The number of applicants is growing every year.

items.prompt: Each of the participants were given a certificate.
answers: Each of the participants was given a certificate.

items.prompt: There is two possible solutions to this problem.
answers: There are two possible solutions to this problem.

items.prompt: She is one of the scientists who works on this project.
answers: She is one of the scientists who work on this project.

items.prompt: Neither of my sisters live in Berlin.
answers: Neither of my sisters lives in Berlin.

items.prompt: A lot of rubbish have been collected.
answers: A lot of rubbish has been collected.

items.prompt: Опишите ваш город или ваших друзей с a number of.
items.sample: A number of my friends have moved abroad in the last few years.

items.prompt: Напишите предложение с one of the people who.
items.sample: My brother is one of the people who never forget a birthday.

items.prompt: Напишите предложение с none of или neither of.
items.sample: None of my colleagues speak Italian.
What I really need is a long holiday.
